narrative.overview: Mode: Operate. Direction: a paper-and-ink research instrument with precise ruled plots, a stable experiment rail, and a wide observation canvas.

rules.name: The Domain Rule
rules.body: Spatial and membership axes retain the declared unit domain. Two-dimensional spatial plots use equal axis scaling. Finite-state points render above the enclosure layer. No viewport or data fit changes the scientific domain.

dos: Do plot finite representatives as points or stems.
Do retain exact API strings in the numerical inspector and export.
Do explain scope and unavailable reference quantities beside the evidence.
donts: Don't interpolate finite representatives into a continuous membership curve.
Don't use neon, purple, gradients, or decorative scientific imagery.
Don't turn a resource exit into a success label.
